description: The plot illustrates the loss of SepLLM models with different configurations over the number of iterations. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale, ranges from 90000 to 130000, and has tick labels at intervals of 5000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", has a linear scale, and ranges from 2.0 to 3.0 with tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains four lines representing different SepLLM configurations: a magenta solid line for SepLLM (n=64, larger lr) starting at approximately 3.0 loss at 90000 iterations and decreasing to around 2.2 at 127000 iterations; a blue solid line for SepLLM (n=128) starting at around 2.9 loss at 90000 iterations and decreasing to approximately 2.3 at 127000 iterations; an orange solid line for SepLLM (n=64) starting at about 3.0 loss at 90000 iterations and decreasing to around 2.3 at 127000 iterations; and a red dashed line remaining constant at approximately 2.35 loss across the entire iteration range. All three solid lines exhibit a sharp decline in loss from 90000 to around 100000 iterations, followed by a more gradual decrease thereafter.
